# Low Level Design: Tracora — Asset Management

| | |
|---|---|
| Version | v0.8 |
| Status | Draft |
| Author | Kishore K |
| Date | 2026-08-31 |
| Derived from | Tracora-PRD-Flow-v0.9, Tracora-HLD-v0.8 |
| App name | `tracora` |

*This is the build specification. Every doctype, field, validation, hook, endpoint and report needed to satisfy the PRD. Where it says a rule is enforced in code, that means a Python validation, not a permission setting.*

---

## 1. App structure

```
tracora/
├── hooks.py
├── tracora/
│   ├── doctype/                 # 12 doctypes
│   ├── report/                  # 8 query reports
│   └── print_format/            # asset label
├── api/
│   ├── lookup.py                # PWA search
│   ├── assign.py                # assign / unassign
│   └── labels.py                # label data + QR
├── integrations/
│   └── hrms.py                  # optional sync
├── reminders/
│   └── scheduler.py             # daily job
├── www/
│   └── scan/                    # PWA portal page
└── public/
    ├── manifest.json
    └── sw.js
```

Everything lives in a versioned app in git. Nothing is built through Customize Form or the workflow builder — those do not travel through review and are lost in migration.

## 2. Doctype inventory

| Doctype | Type | Submittable | Autoname | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tracora Company | Normal | No | `field:company_name` | Owning company of an asset |
| Tracora Branch | Normal | No | Controller `autoname()` | Branch within a company. Named `{branch_name} - {company_abbr}` |
| Tracora Department | Normal | No | Controller `autoname()` | Department within a company. Named `{department_name} - {company_abbr}` |
| Tracora Location | Normal | No | `field:location_name` | Physical place. Not company-qualified — a building can be shared |
| Tracora Employee | Normal | No | Controller `autoname()` | Anyone who can hold an asset. Code from HRMS or typed for staff, issued from the `EXT-` series for an external company's people |
| Tracora Asset | Normal | No | Set in `autoname()` | The asset register |
| Tracora Asset Movement | Normal | No | `TAM-.YYYY.-.######` | Append-only custody history |
| Tracora Maintenance Log | Normal | No | `TML-.YYYY.-.######` | One repair episode |
| Tracora Software Licence | Normal | No | `TSL-.######` | Licence and its dates |
| Tracora Licence Seat | Child | — | — | One user-and-device pair |
| Tracora Reminder Log | Normal | No | `TRL-.YYYY.-.######` | One email attempted |
| Tracora Settings | Single | — | — | Lead days, prefix, label size, sender |

Nothing is submittable. There is no approval chain in the PRD, and a submit/cancel cycle on records that are edited daily adds friction without control. If an approval is wanted later it is a new requirement, not a configuration change.

**Employee code uniqueness (FR-56) is free.** `autoname: field:employee_code` makes the code the primary key, so a duplicate is rejected by the database, not by a validation somebody can bypass. This holds for manual entry and for HRMS sync alike — the sync catches the rejection and reports a conflict rather than merging (§6).

**Branch, department and location are company-qualified.** A bare `field:branch_name` primary key breaks the first time two of the nine companies both have a "Chennai" branch or an "Operations" department, which is close to certain. Branch and department are named `{name} - {company_abbr}` by a controller `autoname()`, following the ERPNext convention. `Tracora Company` therefore carries a `company_abbr` field with a **unique index** — two companies sharing an abbreviation would reopen the same collision one level up.

Location is deliberately *not* qualified. A building is not owned by a company the way a department is, and two companies operating from one address should point at one location record. Dual-source makes this worse rather than better: a department arriving from HRMS and one typed into Tracora land in the same table competing for the same key.

## 3. Field definitions

### Tracora Company

| Fieldname | Label | Type | Req | Links to | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| company_name | Company Name | Data | Yes | — | Primary key |
| company_type | Company Type | Select | Yes | — | `Internal` / `External`. No default (FR-70) |
| company_abbr | Abbreviation | Data | Yes | — | **Unique index.** Qualifies branch and department names |
| company_address | Address | Small Text | Yes | — | |
| source | Source | Select | Yes | — | `HRMS` / `Tracora`. Default `Tracora` |
| hrms_company | HRMS Company | Data | No | — | Stored as text, not Link. Always blank on an External company (FR-71) |

### Tracora Branch

| Fieldname | Label | Type | Req | Links to | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| branch_name | Branch Name | Data | Yes | — | Primary key |
| company | Company | Link | Yes | Tracora Company | |
| source | Source | Select | Yes | — | `HRMS` / `Tracora` |
| hrms_branch | HRMS Branch | Data | No | — | Text, per FR-55 |

### Tracora Department

| Fieldname | Label | Type | Req | Links to | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| department_name | Department Name | Data | Yes | — | Primary key |
| company | Company | Link | Yes | Tracora Company | |
| source | Source | Select | Yes | — | `HRMS` / `Tracora` |
| hrms_department | HRMS Department | Data | No | — | Text, per FR-55 |

### Tracora Location

| Fieldname | Label | Type | Req | Links to | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| location_name | Location Name | Data | Yes | — | Primary key |
| address | Address | Small Text | Yes | — | |
| latitude | Latitude | Float | Yes | — | Precision 6. Range −90 to 90 |
| longitude | Longitude | Float | Yes | — | Precision 6. Range −180 to 180 |
| map_url | Map | Data | — | — | **Virtual.** `is_virtual: 1`, computed from coordinates. Never stored (FR-04) |

`map_url` is a controller property returning `https://www.google.com/maps?q={latitude},{longitude}`. It is not a stored column, so it cannot drift from the coordinates and cannot be edited independently.

**Known limitation.** Virtual fields are computed on the document object, so database queries and the report engine do not return them, and they fail in list views. `map_url` therefore works on the location form and nowhere else. If the link is wanted in a list or an export, that report must build it as a computed column from the coordinates. This is a real constraint of the approach, not an oversight — the alternative is a stored URL that drifts.

### Tracora Employee

| Fieldname | Label | Type | Req | Links to | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| employee_code | Employee Code | Data | Yes | — | Primary key. Unique by autoname. Issued from `EXT-.######` when the company is External (FR-92) |
| employee_name | Employee Name | Data | Yes | — | |
| designation | Designation | Data | No | — | Used mainly for external-company employees |
| mobile | Mobile | Data | Yes | — | |
| email | Email | Data | No | — | |
| date_of_birth | Date of Birth | Date | No | — | Refused when the company is External (FR-75) |
| company | Company | Link | Yes | Tracora Company | |
| branch | Branch | Link | Cond. | Tracora Branch | Required on manual entry for an Internal company; optional otherwise (FR-72) |
| department | Department | Link | Cond. | Tracora Department | Required on manual entry for an Internal company; optional otherwise (FR-72) |
| is_incomplete | Incomplete | Check | — | — | Set by the subscriber when branch or department arrived blank |
| aadhaar_number | Aadhaar Number | Data | No | — | `report_hide: 1`, `no_copy: 1` (FR-39). Refused when the company is External (FR-75) |
| permanent_address | Permanent Address | Small Text | No | — | `report_hide: 1`, `no_copy: 1` (FR-39). Refused when the company is External (FR-75) |
| status | Status | Select | Yes | — | `Active` / `Pending Clearance` / `Exited`. Default `Active` (FR-68) |
| exit_date | Exit Date | Date | No | — | Set when status becomes Pending Clearance or Exited |
| exit_recorded_in | Exit Recorded In | Select | No | — | `Tracora` / `HRMS` (FR-09) |
| source | Source | Select | Yes | — | `HRMS` / `Tracora` |
| hrms_employee | HRMS Employee | Data | No | — | Text, per FR-55 |

**Field ownership (FR-81).** Every field carries an owner, and read-only applies to HRMS-owned fields on a synced record only.

| HRMS-owned | Tracora-owned |
|---|---|
| `employee_name`, `mobile`, `email`, `date_of_birth`, `company`, `branch`, `department`, `status` | `aadhaar_number`, `permanent_address`, `is_incomplete` |

Aadhaar and permanent address stay editable on a synced employee, because HRMS may not hold them and a field that is read-only and permanently empty is a dead field. Read-only is applied in `onload` against this map, not by a fixed property, because one doctype carries both sources.

**External-company employees carry none of the three personal fields.** `date_of_birth`, `aadhaar_number` and `permanent_address` are hidden by `depends_on` when the employee's company is External, and refused in `validate` if a value reaches the server anyway (FR-75). The hide is convenience; the validation is the control.

This is weaker than the separate record type it replaces, where the fields did not exist at all. A validation can be edited; an absent field cannot. Treat it as a rule, not a nicety.

### Tracora Asset

| Fieldname | Label | Type | Req | Links to | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| asset_tag | Asset Tag | Data | Yes | — | Primary key. Unique. Set by `autoname()` |
| tag_mode | Tag Mode | Select | Yes | — | `Auto-generated` / `Manual entry`. No default (FR-41) |
| asset_name | Asset Name | Data | Yes | — | Indexed for search |
| brand | Brand | Data | Yes | — | |
| model_number | Model Number | Data | No | — | |
| serial_no | Serial Number | Data | Yes | — | Unique **per brand**, not globally (FR-13) |
| status | Status | Select | Yes | — | `In Store` / `Assigned` / `Under Maintenance` / `Damaged` / `Lost` / `Recovered` / `Released` / `Retired`. Default `In Store` (FR-14, FR-83, FR-84) |
| condition | Condition | Select | Yes | — | `New` / `Good` / `Fair` / `Poor` / `Not Working` |
| owner_company | Owned By | Link | Yes | Tracora Company | Who owns it. Read-only on the form; changed only via the transfer endpoint (FR-82) |
| holding_company | Held By | Link | Yes | Tracora Company | Who currently has it. Same as owner for an ordinary asset |
| branch | Branch | Link | Cond. | Tracora Branch | Required when `holding_company` is Internal (FR-12, FR-72) |
| location | Location | Link | Yes | Tracora Location | Never blank (FR-05) |
| is_shared | Is Shared | Check | No | — | Marks asset as shared/fixed equipment (e.g. printer, router). Mutually exclusive with `assigned_to` (FR-93). Default 0 |
| point_of_contact | Point of Contact | Link | No | Tracora Employee | Contact person for shared equipment. Does NOT imply custody, does NOT appear in employee custody reports, and does NOT block exit clearance (FR-93) |
| assigned_to | Assigned To | Link | No | Tracora Employee | Set only via the assign endpoint (FR-76) |
| assigned_on | Assigned On | Date | No | — | Set with `assigned_to` |
| label_printed_on | Label Printed On | Datetime | No | — | Last print. Read-only |

`search_fields`: `asset_name, serial_no, brand`. Indexes on `serial_no`, `asset_name`, `assigned_to`, `status`, `owner_company`, `holding_company`.

**Tag and serial share one namespace.** A unique index on `asset_tag` is not enough: a manual tag equal to another asset's serial makes a scan ambiguous, and the search would answer confidently with the wrong asset. Validation checks a candidate tag against both `asset_tag` and `serial_no` across the register, and a candidate serial the same way (FR-13).

**The holder is a single link.** Every person who can hold an asset is a `Tracora Employee`, so there is no type field and no dynamic link. Reports still have to distinguish staff from an external company's people, but they do it by filtering on the company's type rather than on the holder's record type (FR-77).

**Autoname logic (FR-66, FR-67):**

```
def autoname(self):
    if self.tag_mode == "Auto-generated":
        self.asset_tag = make_autoname(get_prefix() + ".######")
    self.name = self.asset_tag
```

The series number is consumed at insert, not at form open. An abandoned draft consumes nothing — which resolves the open question about abandoned numbers without needing a reservation mechanism.

![Tag issue logic](data:image/png;base64,)

Both modes converge on the same cross-field uniqueness check. That convergence is deliberate: an auto-generated tag is not exempt from clashing with a serial number somebody typed last year.

**Shared assets and point of contact (FR-93).** Shared equipment (printers, meeting room projectors, network infrastructure) belongs to a location/branch rather than an individual:
- When `is_shared` is 1, the asset cannot be assigned to any employee (`assigned_to` must be empty). In `api.assign.assign_asset()`, assignment is refused with an explanatory message. If `is_shared` is checked on an asset that currently has `assigned_to` set, validation refuses save until the asset is unassigned.
- `point_of_contact` is an optional reference to an active `Tracora Employee` who handles queries or routine vendor coordination for that asset. It does not transfer custody: the asset is omitted from 'assets by employee' reports, and an employee exiting the company is not blocked by being listed as a point of contact on shared assets.

### Tracora Sync Conflict

| Fieldname | Label | Type | Req | Links to | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| reference_doctype | Record Type | Data | Yes | — | `Tracora Employee`, `Tracora Company`, `Tracora Branch`, `Tracora Department` |
| reference_key | Key | Data | Yes | — | The employee code or record name that could not be applied |
| conflict_type | Conflict Type | Select | Yes | — | `Value mismatch` / `Subscriber failure` |
| hrms_reference | HRMS Record | Data | Yes | — | Text, per FR-55 |
| differing_fields | Differing Fields | Small Text | Yes | — | Comma separated |
| hrms_values | HRMS Values | Code | Yes | — | JSON snapshot at the time of the event |
| tracora_values | Tracora Values | Code | Yes | — | JSON snapshot at the time of the event |
| conflict_status | Status | Select | Yes | — | `Open` / `Resolved`. Default `Open` |

A conflict is a record, not a log line, so it appears as a work list somebody can filter to `Open` and clear. Resolution is manual editing of the Tracora record; there is no merge button.

It is deliberately generic. Keying it to an employee code would leave company, branch and department collisions with nowhere to go, and a subscriber that throws for an unforeseen reason would vanish into the error log — so `Subscriber failure` lands here too, on the same list somebody already checks (FR-56).

## 4. Validation rules

| Rule | Doctype | Hook | Requirement |
|---|---|---|---|
| Serial unique per brand; tag unique across tag and serial | Tracora Asset | `validate` + index | FR-13 |
| Owning company not editable on the form | Tracora Asset | read-only field | FR-82 |
| Lost asset must be Recovered before reassignment | assign endpoint | server method | FR-84 |
| Company abbreviation unique | Tracora Company | unique index | Naming |
| Manual tag must not start with the reserved prefix | Tracora Asset | `validate` | FR-43 |
| Tag mode must be chosen; no default supplied | Tracora Asset | `validate` | FR-41 |
| Location must be present at all times | Tracora Asset | mandatory field | FR-05 |
| Latitude and longitude within valid ranges | Tracora Location | `validate` | FR-03 |
| Assign refused when already assigned | assign endpoint | server method | FR-57 |
| Assign refused when status is Under Maintenance, Lost or Retired | assign endpoint | server method | FR-58 |
| Assign refused when employee status is Exited | assign endpoint | server method | Assign flow |
| Unassign refused without remarks | unassign endpoint | server method | FR-51 |
| Unassign must name a return location | unassign endpoint | server method | FR-52 |
| Tracora exit blocked while assets or seats outstanding | Tracora Employee | `validate` | FR-10, FR-60 |
| HRMS exit never blocked; sets Pending Clearance instead | hrms subscriber | subscriber | FR-68 |
| Pending Clearance employee cannot receive assignments | assign endpoint | server method | FR-69 |
| Pending Clearance clears to Exited on last release | unassign endpoint | server method | FR-69 |
| Employee code unique across sources | Tracora Employee | autoname | FR-56 |
| Company type must be chosen; no default | Tracora Company | `validate` | FR-70 |
| Personal fields refused for an External company employee | Tracora Employee | `validate` | FR-75 |
| Branch and department required for Internal companies only | Tracora Employee, Tracora Asset | `validate` | FR-72 |
| Owning and holding company both required | Tracora Asset | mandatory fields | FR-73 |
| Employee cannot be exited while holding assets or seats | Tracora Employee | `validate` | FR-78 |
| External-company employee code issued from the reserved series | Tracora Employee | `autoname` | FR-92 |
| Licence seat requires both user and device | Tracora Licence Seat | `validate` on parent | FR-21 |
| Duplicate user-and-device pair on one licence | Tracora Software Licence | `validate` | FR-21 |
| User required on a user licence only | Tracora Licence Seat | `validate` on parent | FR-85 |
| Employee with history cannot be deleted | Tracora Employee | `on_trash` | FR-87 |
| Employee code never reused after exit | Tracora Employee | `validate` | FR-88 |
| External company cannot be closed while assets are out | Tracora Company | `validate` | FR-85 |
| Condition on return mandatory when returned | Tracora Maintenance Log | `validate` | FR-18 |
| Movement records cannot be edited | Tracora Asset Movement | `validate` | FR-17 |
| Movement records cannot be deleted | Tracora Asset Movement | `on_trash` | FR-17 |
| Reminder log cannot be edited or deleted | Tracora Reminder Log | `validate`, `on_trash` | NFR-03 |

**Append-only implementation.** Both history doctypes carry the same guard:

```
def validate(self):
    if self.get_doc_before_save():
        frappe.throw(_("History records cannot be edited"))

def on_trash(self):
    frappe.throw(_("History records cannot be deleted"))
```

This throws for every user including Administrator. That is intentional: the PRD says the custody chain is not editable, and a rule that the top role can quietly bypass is not a rule.

## 5. Hooks

Logic for doctypes Tracora owns lives on the controller class, not in `doc_events`. `doc_events` is the mechanism for hooking *another* app's doctypes; using it on your own adds indirection for nothing. It is also unreliable for naming — a naming series in the doctype meta runs before a `doc_events` autoname hook and overrides it.

**On the controller classes:**

| Doctype | Methods |
|---|---|
| Tracora Asset | `autoname()`, `validate()` |
| Tracora Branch / Department / Location | `autoname()` — company-qualified name |
| Tracora Employee | `validate()` — exit check |
| Tracora Software Licence | `validate()` — seat rules |
| Tracora Asset Movement | `validate()`, `on_trash()` — append-only guard |
| Tracora Reminder Log | `validate()`, `on_trash()` — append-only guard |

**In `hooks.py`, the HRMS subscriptions and the scheduler:**

```python
doc_events = {
    # HRMS doctypes. This is what doc_events is for — hooking
    # another app's doctypes. Never fires if HRMS is absent.
    "Employee": {
        "after_insert": "tracora.integrations.hrms.on_employee_change",
        "on_update":    "tracora.integrations.hrms.on_employee_change",
        "after_rename": "tracora.integrations.hrms.on_employee_rename",
        "on_trash":     "tracora.integrations.hrms.on_hrms_delete",
    },
    "Company":    {"on_update": "tracora.integrations.hrms.on_company_change"},
    "Branch":     {"on_update":    "tracora.integrations.hrms.on_branch_change",
                   "after_rename": "tracora.integrations.hrms.on_branch_rename"},
    "Department": {"on_update": "tracora.integrations.hrms.on_department_change"},
}

scheduler_events = {
    "daily": [
        "tracora.reminders.scheduler.run_daily_reminders",
        "tracora.licences.status.mark_expired_licences",
    ],
}

fixtures = [
    {"dt": "Role", "filters": [["name", "in", [
        "Tracora Super Admin", "Tracora Admin"]]]},
    {"dt": "Print Format", "filters": [["name", "in", [
        "Tracora Asset Label"]]]},
]
```

Unfiltered `fixtures = ["Role"]` would export every role on the site into the app. The filter is not optional.

There is no `website_route_rules` entry — a page at `www/scan/` is routed to `/scan` automatically.

**Every subscriber catches its own exceptions.**

```python
def on_employee_change(doc, method):
    try:
        apply_hrms_employee(doc)
    except Exception:
        frappe.log_error(title="Tracora HRMS subscriber")
```

A subscriber that raises aborts the caller's save. If Tracora threw here, an HR user would be unable to save an employee because of a fault in an app they have never heard of. Tracora records the failure and gets out of the way.

No `before_install` HRMS check and no HRMS import anywhere at module scope. A subscriber for a doctype that does not exist is never called.

## 6. Server methods

| Method | Type | Purpose | Requirement |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api.assign.assign_asset(asset, employee, reference)` | Whitelisted | Sets holder, writes an `Assign` movement, applies FR-57, FR-58 and FR-84 | FR-50, FR-76 |
| `api.assign.assign_to_employee(employee, assets[], reference)` | Whitelisted | Same logic, list entry point from the employee screen | FR-50 |
| `api.assign.unassign_asset(asset, location, remarks, condition, status)` | Whitelisted | Requires remarks, writes an `Unassign` movement, flags licence seats | FR-51, FR-52, FR-59 |
| `api.lookup.find_asset(q)` | Whitelisted | PWA search on tag, serial, name | FR-31, FR-32, FR-33 |
| `api.labels.get_label_data(assets[])` | Whitelisted | Returns tag and QR payload for print | FR-44, FR-47 |
| `tags.qr.qr_base64(tag)` | Internal | QR image for the print format | FR-44 |
| `integrations.hrms.on_employee_change(doc, method)` | Subscriber | Applies an HRMS employee change. Never throws | FR-06, FR-56, FR-68 |
| `integrations.hrms.bulk_import()` | Whitelisted, Super Admin only | One-time seed of pre-existing HRMS records | FR-01, FR-02, FR-06 |
| `reminders.scheduler.run_daily_reminders()` | Scheduled | The daily evaluation | FR-63 to FR-65 |

**Assignment is never a direct field write.** `assigned_to` is not editable on the form. It is set only by the endpoints, because a form edit produces no movement record and the custody chain would silently develop a hole.

![Assign endpoint logic](data:image/png;base64,)

Every rejection names what blocked it — the current holder, the status, or the employee's state. A bare "cannot assign" sends the Admin hunting through screens for a reason the server already knew.

The write and the movement record are one transaction. There is no window in which an asset has a new holder and no history entry.

### `api.lookup.find_asset`

Matches `q` against `asset_tag` exact, then `serial_no` exact, then `asset_name` partial. An exact tag or serial match opens that asset directly. A partial name match returns up to twenty rows carrying tag, holder and location for the user to choose from — the system never picks between several matches (FR-91). Returns one payload containing the full asset with both its owning and holding company, the current holder, the open maintenance record if any, the licence seats on the device, and the last twenty movements (FR-32, FR-33).

The holder block is one shape for everyone: name, code, company, mobile, and branch and department where the company is internal.

It does not return `aadhaar_number` or `permanent_address`. The field list is explicit — a `SELECT *` here would put restricted data into a response that a phone caches.

### `integrations.hrms` — subscribers

`on_employee_change` is called by HRMS in the same transaction as HR's save.

![HRMS subscriber logic](data:image/png;base64,)

Every path ends at the same terminal, and none of them throws. A subscriber that raises aborts HR's save, so a Tracora fault would surface to an HR user as a failure in an application they have never heard of.

| Situation in Tracora | What happens |
|---|---|
| Code does not exist | Create with `source = HRMS` |
| Exists with `source = HRMS` | Update the HRMS-owned fields. No conflict is possible — these fields are not editable in Tracora |
| Exists with `source = Tracora`, values match | Attach the HRMS reference, set `source = HRMS`. Nothing else changes |
| Exists with `source = Tracora`, values differ | Write nothing. Raise a `Tracora Sync Conflict` naming the differing fields (FR-56) |
| HRMS marks the employee exited, nothing outstanding | Set `status = Exited` |
| HRMS marks the employee exited, assets outstanding | Set `status = Pending Clearance`. Do not block, do not throw (FR-68) |
| HRMS reverses an exit it recorded | Return to `Active`, but only if Tracora's exit came from HRMS. An exit an Admin set here is never undone by a sync |
| HRMS employee is renamed | Match by `hrms_employee`, not by code, and rename the Tracora document. Never create a second record (FR-56) |
| HRMS employee is deleted | Keep the record, clear `hrms_employee`, set `source = Tracora` so it becomes editable. Never cascade a delete into history |
| Branch or department arrives blank | Create the employee anyway with `is_incomplete = 1` (FR-72) |
| Employee's company changed | Flag every asset they hold for review, naming both companies. Assets do not follow the person (FR-86) |
| Anything throws | Record a `Subscriber failure` conflict. Never surface inside HR's save |

`Pending Clearance` blocks new assignment and clears to `Exited` automatically when the last item is released (FR-69). That check runs on unassign, not on a schedule — the moment the last asset comes back, the employee is closed out.

### `integrations.hrms.bulk_import()`

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Seed employees, companies, branches and departments that existed before Tracora was installed |
| When | Once, at go-live. Also after a reinstall |
| Who | Super Admin |
| Dry run | Default. Produces the full conflict list without writing anything. A real run is a second, deliberate action |
| Behaviour | Same rules as the subscriber table above, applied in a loop |
| Returns | Counts created, counts skipped, and a list of conflicts raised |

This is a migration tool, not an operating feature. Ongoing propagation is the subscribers; there is no scheduled sync and no button anyone presses twice.

## 7. Reminder job

Runs daily.

![Reminder job logic](data:image/png;base64,)

The negative-delta branch is what stops a migrated licence from being silent forever, and the already-logged check is what makes a manual re-run of the job safe.

Pseudocode:

```
lead_days = settings.reminder_lead_days        # [30,15,7,2,1,0]
today = getdate()

for licence in active_licences():
    for kind, date_field in (
        ("Licence Expiry",  "licence_expiry_date"),
        ("Warranty Expiry", "warranty_expiry_date"),
        ("Licence Renewal", "licence_renewal_date"),
        ("Payment Due",     "payment_date"),
    ):
        due = licence.get(date_field)
        if not due:                 continue     # nothing due — FR-63
        delta = date_diff(due, today)
        if delta < 0:                             # already overdue
            send_overdue_once(licence, kind, due)  # FR-89
            continue
        if delta not in lead_days:  continue     # not a lead day
        send_and_log(licence, kind, due, delta)

for log in open_maintenance_with_due_date():
    ... same shape, kind = "Maintenance Due"
```

Three consequences worth being explicit about:

- **Suppression needs no code.** Once a payment is recorded and `payment_date` rolls forward under FR-23, the old date is simply no longer read. Nothing is cancelled because nothing was queued (FR-64).
- **Restart needs no code either.** The rolled-forward date is evaluated on its own merits the next morning, so a new date 20 days out picks up the 15, 7, 2 and 1 day reminders (FR-65).
- **`send_and_log` is guarded by the unique constraint.** A duplicate insert is caught and skipped rather than sent twice, so a manual re-run of the job is safe.

The job writes its finish time to `Tracora Settings`. If that timestamp is more than 48 hours old, or if no active user holds a reminder-receiving role, the application shows a warning banner. A reminder system that has stopped must say so — the absence of an email is otherwise invisible (FR-90).

A due date already in the past when the record is created — normal when migrating licences — produces one overdue notice and a flag on the record, rather than never matching a lead value and staying silent forever (FR-89).

Recipients are resolved by role — every user holding `Tracora Super Admin` or `Tracora Admin` (FR-27). Each recipient is a separate log row, so one failed address fails one row (NFR-05).

## 8. Permissions

Applied to every Tracora doctype unless noted.

| Role | Read | Write | Create | Delete | Report | Export |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tracora Super Admin | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Tracora Admin | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |

Exceptions:

| Doctype | Super Admin | Admin |
|---|---|---|
| Tracora Asset Movement | Read, Create | Read, Create |
| Tracora Reminder Log | Read | Read |
| Tracora Sync Conflict | Read, Write | Read, Write |
| Tracora Settings | Read, Write | Read |

Write and delete on the two history doctypes are absent from the role permission *and* blocked in code. Either alone is insufficient: permissions can be edited through the UI, and code alone leaves a delete button visible that always errors.

No User Permissions are configured. There is no row-level restriction by company or branch — this is a stated decision in the PRD, not an omission.

**Restricted fields.** `aadhaar_number` and `permanent_address` carry `report_hide: 1` and are excluded from every query report's SQL. They remain visible on the employee form to both roles (FR-07, FR-39).

**Unverified.** `report_hide` is expected to remove the fields from the Report Builder column picker; whether it also covers list-view export has **not** been confirmed on the target Frappe version. FR-39 depends entirely on this. Test it before anyone is told Aadhaar cannot leave the system, and if it does not hold, the fallback is moving both fields to a permlevel neither role reads for reporting.

This does not stop a user with the stock `System Manager` role writing a script report or querying the database. That is stated in HLD §9 and controlled by not granting System Manager outside the platform team.

## 9. Reports

All query reports, all with `Tracora Super Admin` and `Tracora Admin` in the report role list. Report roles are set explicitly — a report inherits nothing, and an open report on a restricted doctype leaks the same data.

| Report | Grouped by | Key columns | Requirement |
|---|---|---|---|
| Assets Owned | owner_company | count by status and condition. Owned assets only | FR-36, FR-74 |
| Assets Held | holding_company | everything in our custody, owned or not, ownership shown per row | FR-74 |
| External Custody | holding company, employee | assets placed with clients and partners | FR-77 |
| Assets by Branch | asset branch | count by status, including unassigned stock | FR-36 |
| Assets by Department | department of holder | count by status. Unassigned assets have no department and are reported as a separate row | FR-36, FR-37 |
| Assets by Employee | employee | asset, tag, serial, assigned date. Internal companies only | FR-36, FR-77 |
| Asset Register | — | every asset, full detail | FR-36 |
| Licence Expiry | days remaining | licence, expiry, seats, status | FR-36 |
| Warranty Expiry | days remaining | asset or licence, warranty date | FR-36 |
| Payment Due | due date | licence, amount due date, cycle | FR-36 |

Excel export is the Frappe default on query reports (FR-38). No report SQL selects `aadhaar_number` or `permanent_address` (FR-39).

**Every employee-wise report filters on the company's type explicitly.** Omitting the filter silently counts a client's engineer as headcount, which is precisely the confusion FR-77 exists to prevent. The filter moved from the holder's record type to their company's type; it did not disappear.

**Asset history** is a list view on `Tracora Asset Movement` with standard filters on asset, employee, location, movement type and date range, rather than a report — it is a record list, and building it as a report would lose the link through to each asset (FR-61).

## 10. Print format — Tracora Asset Label

HTML print format, page size taken from settings, default 50 mm × 25 mm.

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| QR code | Encodes `asset_tag` and nothing else. Rendered at 15 mm square minimum (FR-44, FR-46) |
| Tag text | `asset_tag` in readable type beneath the code (FR-45) |
| Asset name | Truncated to fit. Aids visual identification, not machine-readable |

The QR payload is the bare tag string — no URL, no employee name, no company name, no personal data of any kind. Anyone scanning a label found on the street gets a meaningless identifier.

Batch printing (FR-47) renders the same format once per selected asset in a single document. Each print writes a `Label Reprint` movement and updates `label_printed_on` (FR-48).

Dependency: the `qrcode` Python package, declared in the app's `requirements.txt`. It is not assumed present in the bench.

## 11. PWA

| Piece | Detail |
|---|---|
| Route | `/scan`, a Frappe www page. Login required (FR-35) |
| Manifest | `public/manifest.json` — name, icons, `display: standalone`, start URL `/scan` |
| Service worker | `public/sw.js` — caches the app shell only. No asset data cached (HLD §8) |
| Scanner | In-browser camera decode, no native wrapper |
| Search | Single input, posts to `api.lookup.find_asset` |
| Result | Asset detail, holder detail, maintenance, licence seats, recent movements |
| No match | Message naming what was searched. No create path from search (FR-34) |

The service worker caching the shell but never the data is the point. An installed app that opens instantly and then says "no connection" is honest; one that shows last week's holder is not.

## 12. Migration

| Step | Detail |
|---|---|
| 1 | Load companies, branches, departments — from HRMS sync if available, else CSV |
| 2 | Load employees. Employee code is the key; duplicates fail loudly rather than merge |
| 3 | Load locations with coordinates. Assets cannot be loaded first — location is mandatory |
| 4 | Load assets in `Manual entry` tag mode where a physical label exists, `Auto-generated` where none does |
| 4a | Set the tag series counter to the highest existing TRC- number plus one. The counter lives in `tabSeries` and is not restored by a code deploy, so install and migrate both reset it from the data. Tag issue also checks the generated value does not already exist rather than trusting the counter |
| 5 | Load current assignments as `Assign` movements dated the migration date, not backdated |
| 6 | Load licences and seats. A seat needs both user and device, so assets must be loaded first |

**Step 5 is a decision, not a mechanism.** Backdating movements to when an asset was actually issued produces a history that looks complete and is invented. Dating them at migration produces a history that is honest and short. This design takes the second, with a movement remark stating the record was migrated. If you want the first, the source dates have to exist somewhere and someone has to vouch for them.

## 13. Fields assumed, not specified

These are not in the PRD. They are inferred, and each one is a small scope decision rather than a stated requirement.

| Field or record | Why it was added | If you drop it |
|---|---|---|
| Tracora Settings, whole doctype | Lead days, tag prefix and label size hardcoded otherwise | They become code constants, changed by deployment |
| Tracora Sync Conflict, whole doctype | A conflict needs somewhere to live that a person will actually look at | Conflicts go to the error log and are never seen |
| Employee `designation` | External-company employees need a role label; staff have one in HRMS | External holders are a name and a number |
| Movement `from_company` / `to_company` | A device moving to a client changes holding company, and that is a movement worth recording | Company changes are invisible in history |
| `company_abbr` | Needed to qualify branch, department and location names | Names collide across companies |
| Maintenance `due_date` | The maintenance-due reminder has nothing to count down to without it | That reminder type never fires |
| `label_printed_on` | Shows whether an asset has ever been labelled | Reprint tracking is timeline-only |
| `last_renewed_on`, `last_paid_on` | Roll-forward under FR-23 needs a base date | Next dates must be typed manually |
| `licence_name` separate from `software_name` | The PRD lists "asset name" and "software name" as two fields | Probably redundant. Likely one field |

The last row is worth a decision. Two name fields on a licence, both free text, will end up holding the same string.

## 14. Open items

| Item | Why it matters | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Scheduler monitoring | A silently stopped scheduler produces no reminders and no error. The absence of an email is invisible | Kishore |
| Estate relabelling | Whether existing physical labels are kept as manual tags or the estate is relabelled to the TRC- series. Blocks step 4 of migration | Kishore |
| Maintenance due dates | The maintenance-due reminder needs `due_date` populated. If repairs are sent without an expected return, that reminder never fires | Kishore |
| Report row volume | The asset register report is unpaginated. At a few thousand assets this is fine; the threshold where it needs limiting is unmeasured | Kishore |
| Frappe version | **Unresolved.** This document assumes v15. Virtual fields, naming and `report_hide` behave differently on v14 | Kishore |
| `qrcode` package | Assumed installable into the bench. Not confirmed present | Kishore |
| External holder departures | No system can know someone has left the client. The available answer is a report of long-held external assets plus a periodic confirmation, which is a process rather than a feature | Kishore |
| Conflict resolution workload | Every conflict is resolved by hand. Nobody has estimated how many the first bulk import produces | Kishore |
| HRMS doctype names | **Unresolved.** Subscribers assume `Employee`, `Company`, `Branch`, `Department`. If `hrms_custom` renames or wraps any, nothing fires — and that looks identical to HRMS being absent | Kishore |
